pattern.description: The word 'Intent.' splits at the syllable ('Int' / 'ent') as letter colours shift and the full stop shrinks away, then the frame switches to two wobbly gradient blobs that scale up and settle into perfect circles flanking an outline circle inside a contracting outline ring.
pattern.why_premium: The typographic beat literally pulls the word apart to hand off to abstract voice shapes, and the blobs settling from organic wobble into clean circles gives a liquid, tactile resolve instead of a plain cut.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.int', {x:-30, color:'#b0763a', duration:0.25, ease:'power2.in'}).to('.ent', {x:30, color:'#2e6b45', duration:0.25, ease:'power2.in'}, '<').to('.dot', {scale:0, duration:0.2, ease:'power2.in'}, '<').set('.word', {autoAlpha:0}).fromTo('.orb', {scale:0.75, borderRadius:'45% 55% 50% 50%'}, {scale:1, borderRadius:'50%', duration:0.45, ease:'power3.out'}).fromTo('.ring-outer', {scale:1.25}, {scale:1, duration:0.45, ease:'power3.out'}, '<')
build_hint.remotion: Word halves: interpolate(frame,[0,8],[0,30],{easing:Easing.in(Easing.quad)}) on translateX with opposite signs; hard switch on the peak frame; orbs and outer ring driven by spring({damping:200, stiffness:140}) mapping scale 0.75 to 1 (ring 1.25 to 1); blob wobble via an SVG path morph or border-radius interpolation to a circle.

notes: Energy peaks mid-burst where the text frame switches to the orb frame (same shot per code), so the handoff may be a hard switch rather than a true morph. No SFX candidates. Camera verdict none; the scale sum is the orbs growing.
